regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad, deeply negative leadership profile with only the precious-metals complex (Gold, Silver/Royalties) above a poor durability bar and 9 of 16 themes eligible on a loose absolute-trend gate. Backtest verdict is candor-first: momentum rank-IC ~0, rotation timing display-only, and the only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control via the gate — which does help on this market (gate_helps true). The 0.709 hit rate is diluted by a 0.372 directional accuracy, so conviction defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver & Royalties (ca_silver_royalty) can close the 0.173 margin against Gold Miners' leadership on rising breadth and non-crowded structure. The watch retires if XGD.TO (shared proxy) sees Gold Miners hold a durability_bar above 0.60 while Silver's score stops converging for two consecutive weeks.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners carries the strongest composite of the only legs with any standing here: eligible on the absolute-trend gate (the validated risk-control leg, which helps for this market), highest durability_bar (0.66), highest breadth (0.933), and a non-crowded crowding_z (0.54). This is not a return forecast — the momentum rank is a focus lens at best — but it is the cleanest place to retain thematic exposure while the trend discipline does its drawdown-avoidance job.
evidence: eligible: true under the absolute-trend gate (the only validated edge; gate_helps true for Canada/TSX)
durability_bar 0.66 is the highest of all ranks
breadth 0.933 is the highest cohesion reading in the set
crowding_z 0.54, crowded: false — no reflexivity cap needed
theses.dissent: Gold Miners' 10-day return is slightly negative (r10 -0.0054) and hurst_tag is mixed, so the trend may already be stalling; precious-metals leadership can unwind violently on a rate-hike or risk-on surprise, and the detector's own ranking has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes a week below its 20-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Telecom is ineligible under the absolute-trend gate (eligible false) with the second-worst score (-1.04), the worst durability_bar (0.19), zero breadth, and the most negative crowding_z (-1.46). Given the gate is the only validated leg and it explicitly excludes this theme, there is no trend-discipline case to hold it — an avoid rather than an active short, since the detector provides no return-forecasting edge.
evidence: eligible: false — fails the one validated risk-control gate
score -1.04, second-worst in the set; crowding_z -1.46
theses.dissent: Telecom is a defensive yield sector; in a risk-off shock it could hold up better than resource cyclicals, and the mean-revert/mixed hurst regime means an abrupt snap-back is plausible precisely because it is so stretched to the downside.

falsifier.text: XCD.TO gains 5% or more relative to the S&P/TSX over a 2-week stretch before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
